Piab launches PS Series vacuum sensors for automated handling

Three variants span analog monitoring, switching and IO-Link, with NFC setup for supported switches.

Piab / RoboticsTomorrow ↗14 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Feedback at the handling point

Piab introduced the PS Series on October 14 to expose vacuum levels, switching status and operating feedback close to the application. The range is intended to help automated vacuum handling respond to changing conditions.

Three connection options

PS.VA provides continuous analog monitoring. PS.VS combines digital switching and analog output, while PS.VSI adds IO-Link for integration into automation systems needing richer digital feedback.

Phone-based commissioning

The Piab Connect app uses NFC to adjust settings, copy configurations and read statistics on supported switches. Easier commissioning is the intended benefit; the announcement provides neither pricing nor field-test reductions in handling failures.
